reuse.why: Extends the existing getExpectedScheduleAmount and uses the existing getApproxNumberThreshold for the tolerance instead of recomputing 7.5%.

duplication.why: The approximate rule is written once in the shared helper; callers only pass their op.

placement.why: The rule lives in shared/schedules.ts beside the ranged worst-case rule it extends.

scope.why: Only the helper, its four callers and the tests change.

maintainability.why: Clear and centralised, though the op argument is optional and untyped (string), so a future caller that forgets it silently loses the rule, and the callers' 'Ranged amounts...' comments are now incomplete.

bypasses_abstraction.where: All expected-amount callers (api-models, schedules/app updateActions and postTransactionForSchedule, computeSchedulePreviewTransactions) go through getExpectedScheduleAmount.

one_place.where: packages/loot-core/src/shared/schedules.ts getExpectedScheduleAmount, called with the op by every planning/posting path that applies the worst-case rule.
